Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: The latest job report shows unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center known for authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, panoramic skyline views, and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your website. It's clean and simple, and your contact email is easy to find. To improve it, you could add more about yourself, such as your projects, interests or background, and use a bit of visual design to make it more engaging. Nice start!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog. It has a friendly, personal tone, and I like that you mention hiking as your hobby. To improve it, you could add posts with trail stories, photos and tips, plus some navigation and a way to contact you. Great start!
